# DESK_V022_ATTRIBUTION (generated by code/th_algo/ar_attrib.py; order 0322Z item 1; research only)

Rows: TL3_DX_<S>_<MF>_DK3NOSEAT_A (alone-bare desk DK3NOSEAT) matched on book + signal time to the same book on its own fixed bracket (fix_A), window = the months the managed set has (Asia / London 37 months 2023-09..2026-10, NY AM / NY PM 24 months 2024-10..2026-10). Categories as in the same-trade counts (managed R vs own-bracket R differs by >= 0.25 R of the book stop; own-bracket peak from the 1-s tape). $ = p484, managed minus own bracket, whole window, live lots. The rule = how the MANAGED trade ended: exit_name ExAlgoAll_<rule> = the desk closed it by that rule; ExAlgoStop_<rule> or Stop with algo_rule = the stop the desk tightened by that rule was hit; plain Stop with no rule = the 1.5x safety stop. Rule codes: OB1 = first objective (take half / 1-lot tighten); OB2 = second objective (take the rest); OB = objective while DEFEND (take all); AB = ABORT; DV = divergence exit; CL = bell-closing clock (distance wanted > NQ can cover); N3 = clock: last minute with open profit; DF = DEFEND before free (take half); NB = never-bend / free-trade stop (to entry); RT = structure trail (behind last swing / half the peak); EV = stop before a top-tier release.
